standard_prerequisites.name: Adjunction for fibred categories
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the fibred-level adjunction equivalence Mor_{Fib/C}(S, u^pT) = Mor_{Fib/D}(u_pS, T).

standard_prerequisites.name: Universal property of stackification
standard_prerequisites.use: Extends the adjunction across stackification: Mor_{Fib/C}(S, X) = Mor_{Stacks/C}(S', X) with S' the stackification.

standard_prerequisites.name: Stacks versus fibred categories
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies i-morphisms of stacks with i-morphisms of fibred categories for i = 1, 2.

core_obligations: Record that i-morphisms of stacks are the same as i-morphisms of fibred categories.
Invoke the fibred-level adjunction between Mor categories.
Apply the stackification universal property with X = u^pT = f_*T and S' = f^{-1}S to transfer the adjunction to stacks.
proof_roadmap: Chain the fibred-level adjunction with the stackification universal property, using the identification of stack morphisms with fibred-category morphisms.
